Luqata

A clearer path to recovering lost items

  • Flutter
  • Image recognition
Problem
Someone who lost an item may struggle to find the corresponding report, especially when the two people describe the same item differently.
Audience
People who have lost an item and people who have found one.
Project status
A team mobile application project associated with King Saud University, built with Flutter.
My contribution
I contributed as a team member. Analysis, interface design, and development are documented at the project level.
A design decision
The team used image recognition to propose matches. After filing a lost or found report, users can review and dismiss suggestions or submit a claim. The two parties can communicate through chat.
Documented outcome
The team built an app that brings reporting, suggested matches, claims, and chat into a single recovery flow.
